detail.title: Data Collection Station/Data Collection Module with Type-C interface
detail.overview: Compare Favourite EEC300D8-N1 Data Collection Station/Data Collection Module with Type-C interface Key Points 1. Data Collection Module of Wall-mounted Data Collection Station; 2. Electronic lock design for each dock which can be unlocked only by authorized users; 3. Mechanical lock at the bottom which can be used to unlock docks; 4. EEC300D8-N1 must connect to a Control Module EEC300, can't work separately; 5. Type C USB cable. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Basic Parameters.Key Lock: 1 (open all docks at the same time)
Basic Parameters.Indicator Light: Yes. Blue & red indicator. Two indicators for each dock (one for data collection, and one for charging indication)
Basic Parameters.Extension (Male/Female): 2 on each side (for connecting control module or expanding data connection module)

Function.One-tap Unlock: Yes. One-tap on EEC300 to unlock all docks.
Function.Single-dock Unlock: Yes. Support unlock single dock through EEC300.
Function.Unlock by Key: Each data collection module can be unlocked though the lock at the bottom.
Function.Unlock after Power-off (Battery): Yes. The built-in lithium battery in EEC300 enables unlocking of all docks through the lock at the bottom of EEC300D8-N1 for 10 days in case the EEC300 turns off.
Function.Priority Collection: Yes. Docks in the first row can be configured to have faster download speed than others when EEC300 connect more than one EEC300D8-N1.

General.Power Supply: Powered by the extension port of the control module
General.Micro USB Charging Port: Supports overloading protection.Each output is 5 V/1.5 A
General.Installation: Wall mounted with Control Module; top and ground distance: 1.6 m–1.8 m (5.25 ft–5.91 ft)
